Blind recompute for a study in an agent-based simulation (ACL study ES2). Please compute only from the data below; you have not seen and should not guess any earlier result. TABLE A, 32 paired seeds; three arms per seed: v11 (baseline), r (a new learning rule), sham (a trivial change); for each arm n = habit updates closed (years 100-200) and sum_abs = sum of |q - G| over them (gap between a habit value and the return later realized). TABLE B, the same seeds, the action 'rest' only, for v11 and r: rest_n and rest_sum_abs. Compute: (1) pooled mean error M = total sum_abs / total n for v11, r, sham (4 decimals); (2) D_r = M_r - M_v11 and D_sham = M_sham - M_v11 with 95% intervals by a paired world bootstrap (resample the 32 seeds with replacement 10,000 times keeping each seed's arms together, recompute pooled M per arm, take the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles); (3) from TABLE B, the pooled mean error for rest in v11 and in r and the rise (r minus v11); (4) apply this frozen rule (other guards are checked elsewhere and were not raised; ignore them): 'supported' only if D_r < 0 and its upper bound < 0 and D_r < D_sham AND the rise for rest is not more than 0.10; else 'not supported'. Report M per arm, D_r and D_sham with intervals, rest's two means and the rise, and the reading. Run code if you can.
